note: temporary key; keep it. Send it as X-API-Key.

reuse_hint.message: A key does not expire: create it once, keep it (for example in JANCTION_RENDER_API_KEY) and send it as X-API-Key on every call; GET /v1/me checks a key you already have.

large_files.how: POST /v1/files carries one request of up to 100 MB; a larger body is refused by the CDN with an HTML 413 before it reaches the API. For a larger file: run uvx janction-render preview <file> (the CLI sends it in parts and resumes), or send it in parts yourself with POST /v1/uploads (tus 1.0: POST with Upload-Length and Upload-Metadata, PATCH parts of 32 MiB with Upload-Offset, then GET it for the scene_id; GET /v1/uploads/limits gives the sizes), or pass an https link as scene_url.
large_files.do_not_shrink: Do not decimate, strip textures from or re-save the user's scene to make it fit: the render would no longer be what they made. If a smaller file seems the only way, ask them first.
